description: Update a field (or fields) in many records at once. Instead of N update_record calls for 'set status Processed on all of today's orders'. Records can be chosen by a list of IDs, by a filter (field = value), by a report, or all records of the form. Supports action rules — triggers fire as on an ordinary update.

fields_to_set.description: Fields to update: {"Field name" or field_id: "new value"}. For example: {"Status": "Processed", "Priority": "Low"}

filter.description: Filter by one field: {field: "Field name", value: "value"}. For example: {field: "Status", value: "New"}

record_ids.description: The specific record IDs to update. If not given, filter or report_id or all records are used.

report_id.description: Report/filter ID — updates only the records in this report

name: bulk_update_records
